name: markdown-view
title: Markdown View
description: Render a markdown string to safe, token-styled HTML — headings, lists, code, blockquotes, links, GFM tables — XSS-safe, no raw HTML.

meta.whenToUse: Display user/system-authored markdown — descriptions, comments, activity — as safe token-styled prose.
meta.whenNotToUse: Editing markdown (use an editor), or when the source needs embedded raw HTML.
